## A stronger protected capability is now constructed

I obtained an explicit **six-qubit autonomous memory that protects unknown quantum information against both bit and phase errors, with continuing noise on its controller**. The recovery’s logical action is derived from its physical Hamiltonian, and its finite response is certified for the actual joint dynamics.

The resource trade is substantial and explicit: **five data qubits, one reset qubit, and 185 Hamiltonian Pauli terms acting on at most five qubits**. This establishes a stronger capability than the earlier biased two-body memory. A reliable two-body realization and a scalable threshold remain open.

The central advance in this attack is the combination of:

- physical recovery operators that preserve the decoded logical state throughout every recovery excursion;
- an exact, noise-weighted occupation certificate that bounds the complete output quantum channel;
- continuous noise on all six qubits, including general one-site Hamiltonian and Lindblad perturbations;
- a uniform tolerance bound for independent errors in the physical interaction coefficients.

The complete work is preserved here:

- [Autonomous_Full_Pauli_Memory_20261101.pdf](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_804829799358819193c1d77465869513&account_id=personal) — the construction, proofs, numerical results, resource accounting, and source audit.
- [Autonomous_Quantum_Memory_Continuation_20261101_Proofs_and_Code.zip](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_60e5e4f1ac1c81918438c285939dbecf&account_id=personal) — 112 files containing both stages of the attack: the initial models, full-channel calculations, recovery-history argument and failures, plus the new physical recipe, ordinary proofs, exact witnesses, and replay code.
